cpu.detector_scope: Integer CA thresholds/hits only; excludes X1 clustering/top-32
cpu.render_scope: CPU render only, no framebuffer copy/LCD transport or RX; not display fps

latency.definition: First accepted IQ sample after arm to next list-ready pulse; includes frame acquisition

digital_throughput.scope: Accepted test-source IQ and post-Welch power-frame events, AVG_SHIFT=0

receive.scope: PL spectrum/waterfall; PS updates text/list once per second
